## Standing operator rules
Every sandbox third-party credential must use the ledgerly_sbx prefix and be referenced through settings/vendor_sbx.toml rather than an environment variable.

“Safely upgrade payments-api to version 2.8.0-rc.3 through a US canary followed by EU and APAC production rollouts. Run these steps in order, one at a time.”

Please keep commits small so review stays easy.

Never edit api/openapi.yaml without first posting the proposed diff in #ledgerly-api and tagging @dana-api.

The ci-runner-small pool is being retired and jobs there hang; integration jobs must target ci-runner-arm64 from now on.

Paste exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing.

## Current objective
Fix webhook signature verification failures causing 400s in `ledgerly/webhooks/stripe.py`. Invoice pagination is superseded.

## Key identifiers and corrections
Clusters: `prod-us-east-1`, `prod-eu-west-1`, `prod-ap-south-1`; namespace: `payments`; image: `registry.acme.io/payments-api:2.8.0-rc.3`; job: `api-2-8-0-schema`; integration pool: `ci-runner-arm64`.

## Ruled-out approaches
Disabling idempotency middleware caused duplicate staging invoices.

## Plan and progress
Steps 1–6 done; 7–8 pending. Next exact command was not recorded. Webhook diagnosis pending; `pytest -q` status: completed, 118 passed, 7 skipped.

## Recent work
US canary upgraded successfully to rc.3. Worker memory fix passed full suite. CLI billing filters were consolidated; all 15 CLI and 22 command tests passed, and duplicate currency help was removed.
